title: Thiel Macro Vista stake disclosed
summary: Current capital-deployment update for a core PayPal-alumni actor; the disclosure does not establish PayPal-alumni syndication or co-investment.

sources.title: Billionaire Peter Thiel buys 1% stake in Argentine Vaca Muerta oil firm, filing shows

data.name: Thiel Macro Vista stake disclosed
data.description: A U.S. SEC filing published August 14, 2026, reported by Reuters on August 16, disclosed that Peter Thiel's Thiel Macro LLC held about 1.2 million Vista American Depositary Shares worth about $76 million, roughly 1% of Vista. This is a Thiel-linked capital-deployment record and does not by itself establish PayPal-alumni syndication or co-investment.
actions: Thiel Macro LLC disclosed a roughly 1% ownership stake in Vista in a U.S. SEC filing.
